messages: I met a fisherman named #p100# in #m10000000#. He wants to get his wife a nice flower basket for their upcoming anniversary and asked if I could get him #b10 #t4031042#s#k for her. According to him, a #p609# can take me to the flower's location. #m10005000#... #m10005000#?!?!?! That's FAR!!!

I got #p100# all #b10 #t4031042#s#k. With these, he can make a beautiful flower basket for his wife on their anniversary. As a sign of appreciation, #p100# got me a whole bunch of screws that were left over from parts of a ship. By the way, if there are this many screws that had fallen out of that ship, then how in the world is it even still sailing...? Is it still carrying passengers???
name: [Deep Forest of Patience] John's Pink Flower Basket
